references.text: The first census of the tribe of Naphtali also showed 53,400 men, confirming the consistency in the census
The second census of the tribe of Naphtali on the plains of Moab, showing the tribe's development over time in the wilderness
Naphtali was the son of Jacob and Bilhah, Rachel's maidservant, and this is the origin of the tribe of Naphtali
Jacob's blessing over Naphtali, which prophesied about the tribe's future
Moses' blessing over the tribe of Naphtali before his death
